items.headline: JJ Gabriel asks to leave Manchester United over first-team opportunities
items.summary: 15-year-old academy prodigy formally requested registration cancellation. Multiple top clubs including Man City monitoring situation after family issues with club.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel refused to train after relationship issues with club
items.summary: Teenage sensation declined to train with first team. Had expected to become youngest United player ever in League Cup match vs Brighton.

items.headline: Man City among clubs monitoring JJ Gabriel departure from United
items.summary: 15-year-old star requested immediate registration cancellation. Manchester City, Chelsea, Real Madrid and Barcelona all tracking situation.
